name: chatgpt-pro-bridge
description: Run Pro prompts through signed-in ChatGPT or the headless Responses API and archive complete responses outside agent context.

interface.shortDescription: Archive Pro browser or API responses outside agent context.
interface.longDescription: Uses a fresh isolated worker for every Pro bridge request so the main agent never owns browser/API waiting or output checking. GUI hosts can start a new signed-in ChatGPT Pro chat; headless hosts can run an independent GPT-5.5 Pro Responses API request with high-context Web Search. Both paths archive private response-only records and return only paths, counts, hashes, usage, and verification status.
interface.defaultPrompt: Run this prompt as a fresh Pro request using one fresh dedicated worker. Use the headless Responses API with Web Search when Browser is unavailable, archive the complete response in zero-body mode, and return only paths, counts, hashes, usage, and verification status.
